name: hope-capital-lottery
reviewNotes: All 19 original glyph records reviewed. Preserve the 100 ryo ticket price, 10000/3000/1000 ryo prizes and consolation millet dumpling.
The special-prize dialogue describes the original Hudson mail-in promotion with a 1994-04-30 deadline. Keep that historical date; this is not a current promotion.

Record 18's fixed code was enlarged and visually verified as ねでいな えしおは にちだもと. Preserve all thirteen kana verbatim, intentionally untranslated; omit decorative quotation/group padding to fit one 14-cell line, retaining both source newlines and outer blank-line spaces.
Only text is drafted; lottery timing, outcomes, rewards and the special code are not changed.
